source: Branch ci-exploration at b9b5878 (.github/ci-exploration/e7.sh and firefox-webgl.mjs); raw output on the temporary ci-exploration-results-e7 branch
method: Firefox 142.0.1 (Playwright 1.56.0) was launched once per preference set and probed for WebGL2 and WebGL1, recording the context-creation failure message. On Linux the probe ran again after installing Mesa's EGL and GLES packages, headless and then headed under xvfb-run. The first working set then ran npm run test:firefox through an exploration-only patch of the launch options in firefox-smoke.js.
variants: all of the above except webgl.out-of-process

windows-2025.forceEnabled: WebGL2 on ANGLE (Microsoft Basic Render Driver, Direct3D 11), i.e. WARP; same with every other variant
windows-2025.inProcessWebgl: the page crashes (also on the maintainer's machine)
